description:
Eighteen test functions in the DVB-T2 campaign binary are named without the required prefix, so they do not match the convention the rest of the workspace follows.

## Background

The project names test functions `test_<operation>_<scenario>`. The affected functions in `crates/gf2-sim/src/bin/dvb_t2_awgn_campaign.rs` are named for the scenario alone, so a filtered run that selects on the prefix silently skips them.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: All eighteen test functions in the campaign binary are named `test_<operation>_<scenario>`.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each renamed function keeps its original assertions; no test is dropped, merged, or weakened.
- [hard] REQ-03: No test function in the binary lacks the prefix afterwards.
- [hard] REQ-04: The suite passes, and clippy with warnings denied plus formatting pass.
title: Add the required test prefix to the gf2-sim campaign binary tests
